angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 479,337 km at 44.63 pc = 0.14 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 22.4063 +/- 0.0166 mas (same row, RUWE 1.05): 44.63 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.689 +/- 0.021 solar radii from Polanski et al. 2021, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Wolf 503 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..238P/abstract): 479,337 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.688 +/- 0.023 solar masses from Polanski et al. 2021, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Wolf 503 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..238P/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4716 +/- 60 K from Polanski et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Wolf 503 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..238P/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Polanski et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Wolf 503 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..238P/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wolf-503.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.599, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Wolf 503 (pscomppars): spectral type K3.5 V, from Polanski et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..238P/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Wolf 503 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.47 dex, from Polanski et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..238P/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Wolf 503 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.67572, from Polanski et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..238P/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Wolf 503 (pscomppars): age 11 Gyr, from Polanski et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..238P/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, BD-05 3763: projected rotation speed 1.5 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2022ApJS..259...35A)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
